prereg.hypothesis: Cards with narrative crowding >= 0.8 have larger realised |excess return| than other cards.
prereg.metric: difference in mean |excess return|, CROWDED minus NORMAL, settled cards only
prereg.decision: SUPPORTED if difference > 0 and Welch t > 2 with >= 30 cards per group; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED
prereg.direction_use: none until supported as a volatility signal
